claims.text: SPA's English release datelined Jeddah, August 13, 2026 says King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud issued royal orders that day.
claims.locator: Dateline and opening sentence; trailer (17:41 local time)
claims.uncertainty: A point observation 25 days before the cutoff. It does not certify continuity through 7 September 2026.

claims.text: The first order reconstitutes the Cabinet with its current members under the chairmanship of Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, styled Crown Prince and Prime Minister, citing earlier royal orders that limit a Cabinet's term to four years.
claims.uncertainty: Attests both styles on this date. It does not establish uninterrupted tenure since 2017 (Crown Prince) or 2022 (Prime Minister).
